findings.title: Public bundle visible at final path before last authorization recheck
findings.message: The gates and source state are checked only before the output directory is created and after the move. The checks are sampled, so the release can be modified between them. The final recheck happens after the bundle is already in place at the output path. A concurrent consumer could see an unauthorized public bundle at the final path before it is removed.
findings.suggestion: Perform the final authorization recheck on the staged bundle before moving it into place, or stage and then atomically rename it to the output path after the last check.
